what: Federal tax authority. Famously legacy IT — IRS Master File runs since 1960s.
mainframe_systems: IBM z/OS · IBM z14/z15 · CADE (Customer Account Data Engine)
known_systems: Individual Master File (IMF), Business Master File (BMF), CADE 2 partial modernization
default_role: IRS Information Technology Office · Enterprise Architecture
digital: Individual Master File written in IBM Assembler + COBOL · 1962
CADE 2 modernization project running since 2009 — partial progress
Multiple GAO reports flagging modernization risk; Inflation Reduction Act funding ($80B over 10yr)
competition: Booz Allen, MITRE, Accenture Federal, Lockheed Martin

abc.a: The IRS Individual Master File is the most-cited legacy modernization risk in US government. Inflation Reduction Act money is funding the work — and AI translation tools that drop fields silently are the exact category of risk the IG has warned about.
abc.b: Deterministic field parity, .gov hardware only, FedRAMP-ready
